Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

A traves de sus recuerdos y experiencias, reviven un viaje realizado anos atras por el Caribe colombiano, las sierras y montanas de Colombia, Peru y Ecuador, compartiendo historias y lugares que invitan a conocer otras culturas y a encontrar bienestar en el camino.

programme.title: Impostora
programme.desc: Nimfa, an ugly street vender, meets jeremy, a talented plastice surgeon, in a car accident. To compensate for what happened, jeremy offers to help Nimfa by giving her new face through surgery. In her desire to change her life and escape her situation, she willingly undergoes complete facial reconstruction. She later discovers that her face is copied from Rosette, a wealthy and married woman who happens to be jeremy's lover. Rosette wants to escape her life with her husband and their kids. Forced to accept her circumstance, Nimfa becomes an imposer so Rosette and Jeremy can get away with their affair.

programme.title: Eye Candy
programme.desc: Yasmin Lander from Norwich has wanted one thing above all else since she was a child: to become a female wrestler. She has been training for many years, making her debut in 2011. But the pink-clad upper-class girl she is supposed to embody doesn't suit her. She takes time off and creates a new alter ego: tomboy Charlie Morgan - tough, direct, self-confident.

programme.title: Hippos, Israel
programme.desc: Hippos (Sussita) est une ancienne ville greco-romaine situee sur une colline surplombant la mer de Galilee dans le nord d’Israel. Fondee a l’epoque hellenistique, elle a prospere en tant que partie de la Decapole et est aujourd’hui connue pour ses impressionnantes ruines, ses rues, ses temples, sa basilique et ses portes de ville, temoignant d’un riche melange de culture classique et d’histoire chretienne ancienne.

And there is already a sperm donor for the child, the contract is as good as signed, everything seems lined up. For Katha's bachelorette party, her childhood friend Charly has come up with a special surprise: a weekend with "the boys".

programme.title: Indonesia: Bosques de lo extraño

programme.title: Site de bapteme de Yardenit, Israel

Reconnu comme un site traditionnel associe au baptême de Jesus, il accueille des pelerins du monde entier pour la reflexion spirituelle, la priere et les ceremonies de baptême dans un cadre naturel serein.

La ville fortifiee de Tel Afek, a mi-chemin entre Jerusalem et Cesaree, se trouve aujourd’hui dans un parc calme et silencieux. Le site est proche des sources perennes de la riviere Yarkon et fait desormais partie du parc national de Yarkon en Israel. programme.sub-title: Sur les rives de la Garonne
programme.desc: Des Pyrenees espagnoles ou elle prend sa source, au vaste estuaire de la Gironde ou elle se jette, la Garonne parcourt plus de 600 kilometres a travers le Comminges, l'Agenais ou l'Entre-deux-Mers. Le fleuve evolue au cours de ce long voyage. L'apport de ses affluents, comme la Neste, l'Ariege, le Tarn et le Lot, modifie son visage. A bord d'un helicoptere, Didier Taillefer part en Espagne pour faire des photos aeriennes de l'une des principales sources du fleuve : le Trou du Toro. Ce site exceptionnel est situe au pied du massif de la Maladeta, ou la Garonne disparaît sous terre avant de reapparaître au Val d'Artan. Au coeur des Pyrenees, le fleuve donne naissance a un jardin de Cocagne : le Comminges. Dans le village de Huos, Remy Martin a amenage un verger-potager bio sur un ancien meandre.

programme.title: Min Motorsport - Et Roadracing løp kommer sjeldent uten problemer

programme.title: Min Motorsport - Årets første "wet-race" på ACR står for tur.
programme.desc: Lokasjonen for Roadrace-konkurransen er Arctic Circle Raceway! Det er første gangen Alf skal kjøre på vått føre, og Steffen har endelig fått orden på sykkelen sin. Men hos Team Kaos kan alt skje, og løpet tar en rask og uforventet vending.

programme.title: Min Motorsport - Siste løp i Superbike 2017!
programme.desc: Om serien: I denne serien følger vi forskjellige motorsportutøvere gjennom deres racingsesong. Sporten, målene og forutsetningene er forskjellige, men felles for dem alle er lidenskapen for sporten sin og miljøet de er i.

programme.title: Min Motorsport - Roadracing med Steffen og Team Kaos
programme.desc: Steffen er en del av vennegjengen Team Kaos, og de har virkelig fortjent navnet sitt. De kjører alle roadracing,og medlemmene har forskjellig erfaring og konkurrerer i ulike klasser. Vi møter dem på Vålerbanen for sesongens første testkjøring.

programme.title: Garasjen - Testkjøring av Volvo 142, Formula Offroad bygging og motivlakkering av Audi.
programme.desc: Ivar og Asgeir skal teste Volvoen de har mekket på, og får noen tips på kjøreteknikk av en som virkelig kan det. Norges beste varebilsjåfør skal kåres. Vi møter også Sigurjon som skal bygge seg en Formula offroad bil helt fra scratch.

programme.title: Garasjen - Drifting på Rudskogen, Lille Bjørn og Rally Monte Carlo Historiqe start!
programme.desc: Vi treffer Tor Anders Ringnes, som lenge har jobbet med å gjøre bilen klar for driftssesongen. Bilen skal være klar til Rudskogen motorfestival. Videre går turen til Jarle i Risør, som åpner dørene til garasjen sin.

programme.title: Garasjen - Rally Monte Carlo Historiqe, Garasjebesøk i Kristiansand og ferdigstilling av Audien!
programme.desc: Ivar og Asgeir deltar i Rallye Monte Carlo Historique. Vi besøker garasjen til Melvin i Kristiansand. Asgeir har jobbet hardt for å få ferdig Audien sin. Nå er det klart for siste finish, før bilen skal EU-godkjennes.

programme.title: Jeg går elektrisk - Jeg går elektrisk...med Audi e-tron GT
programme.desc: Audi eTron har vært en stor salgsuksess i Norge, og nå har de kommet med en mer sportslig utgave: Audi eTron GT. Vil Ståle sette like stor pris på denne sportslige utgaven, som han satte på Porsche Taycans sportlige utgave?

programme.title: Jeg går elektrisk - Jeg går elektrisk...med Skoda Enyaq iV
programme.desc: Bilverden utvikler seg, og elbiler blir mer og mer vanlig. Med den skeptiske motorentusiasten Ståle Eskeland i spissen får vi et innblikk i hvordan bilene faktisk er å kjøre. Et biltest-program av elbiler, fra en motorelskers perspektiv.

programme.title: Jeg går elektrisk - Jeg går elektrisk...med BMW i3
programme.desc: Denne gangen tester Ståle BMW i3. Men kan den egentlig kalles for en sporty bil?

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1980-1990
programme.desc: 80-tallet er preget av racinglegender. En ny verdensmester kommer på banen, og viser frem motorer med 1.200 hester. Porche 959 er den raskeste landeveisbilen i verden. Motorsport har mer å si enn noen gang, og tiårene er fyllt med store motorer.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1947-1960
programme.desc: På slutten av 1940 og 1950 går vi mot en ny start. Etter krigen nærmest stoppet bilutviklingen og produksjonen helt opp, men produsenter fra Frankrike, England og USA begynte sakte bygge biler til sivile igjen.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1960-1970
programme.desc: 1960-tallet er fargerikt og bilmarkedet vokser. Småbiler er blitt veldig populære, og middelklassen er på utkikk etter bil. Hvis du har råd, vil drømmen din gå i oppfyllelse.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1970-1980
programme.desc: På 70-tallet utløste oljekrisen et produksjonsskjelv. Kundene endret kjøpsatferd og gjorde økonomiske småbiler til bestselgere. Sikkerhets aspekter ble mer og mer vanlig, og datateknologi ble brukt til å bygge biler.

programme.title: Einzeltest
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: Vorfahrt
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Nio Battery-Swap
programme.desc: Der chinesische Autohersteller Nio geht das Thema "E-Auto laden" anders an als die Konkurrenz. In sogenannten Battery-Swap-Stations soll der Akku innerhalb von nur fünf Minuten gewechselt werden. Ist das die Zukunft der Elektromobilität? Alexander Bloch testet die Anlage und klärt die 9 größten Irrtümer zum Akkuwechsel beim E-Auto.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Golf 7
programme.desc: Der VW Golf 7 ist eines der meistverkauften und beliebtesten Modelle des Volkswagenkonzerns. Worauf man beim Kauf eines gebrauchten Golf 7 achten muss erklärt Alexander Bloch. Egal ob Probleme mit dem AGR-Ventil, dem DSG-Getriebe und Rost, die Schwachstellen und guten Seiten des Wolfsburger Dauerbrenners kommen hier zum Vorschein.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - 1.000.000 Kilometer
programme.desc: In der 100. Folge von Bloch erklärt kümmert sich Alex um das Thema Dauerläufer: Wie hält dein Auto ewig? Im Mittelpunkt steht ein Lexus LS400 mit einer Million Kilometer auf der Uhr. Wie fährt sich so ein Kilometerfresser eigentlich? Und was muss man tun, damit das eigene Auto auch das Zeug zum Dauerläufer hat? Alex Bloch erklärt euch 10 wichtige Regeln - das wird gut!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - E-Autos 2023
programme.desc: Die Lieferzeiten bei Elektroautos sind lang. Doch zumindest wird 2023 die Auswahl deutlich größer. Besonders die chinesischen Hersteller wollen angreifen und zeigen zahlreiche Neuheiten. Aber auch die deutschen Produzenten legen nach. Alexander Bloch zeigt seine 10 Highlights für das Jahr 2023. Hier seht ihr seine Favoriten.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Sicherheits-Irrtümer
programme.desc: Welche Autos sind am sichersten? Welche Aussagekraft haben Crashtests überhaupt? Warum spielt die Farbe eines Autos in der Unfallstatistik eine Rolle? Die Antwort auf diese Fragen und weitere spannende Informationen rund um das Thema Verkehrssicherheit gibt es in dieser Folge Bloch erklärt. Zudem findet Alexander Bloch unter den Testdummies einen neuen Freund: Thor!

programme.title: Die 7
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Porsche Taycan im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Porsche hat den Taycan umfangreich überarbeitet und in vielen Disziplinen verbessert. Die Batterie wird größer und kann schneller Laden. Alex Bloch fährt den Basis Taycan mit großer Batterie im E-Auto-Supertest und kommt aus dem Grinsen nicht mehr raus. Wie die Chancen stehen, dass der Taycan auf die Pole Position der Elektroautos fährt, seht ihr im Video.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der MG4 Electric im E-Auto Supertest
programme.desc: Der MG4 schwimmt auf der Erfolgswelle! Der Überflieger befindet sich unter den Top 5 der meistverkauften Elektroautos in Deutschland. Was der chinesischen Kompaktstromer im Vergleich zum Opel Astra Electric und dem VW ID.3 drauf hat, klärt Alexander Bloch.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Opel Astra Electric im EAS
programme.desc: Kein anderes Auto hat Alexander Bloch bisher in ein solches Wechselbad der Gefühle geschmissen. Von „sensationell!“ bis „macht ihr Witze?“ ist alles dabei. Was die Stärken und Schwächen des Opel Astra Electric sind und ob er sich gegen den VW ID.3 behaupten kann, erfahrt ihr hier!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Mercedes E-Actros 600: Die 5 GIGA-Fakten zum neuen Elektro-Truck
programme.desc: Mercedes-Benz Trucks präsentiert den E-Actros 600, einen batterieelektrischen 40-Tonner, der ohne Zwischenladung mehr als 500 Kilometer weit fahren soll. Alexander Bloch durfte sich den Elektro-LKW bereits exklusiv anschauen und erklärt die 5 Giga-Fakten zum neuen Mercedes E-Actros 600.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Sparen mit dem Elektroauto: Das bringt was - und das bringt nichts!
programme.desc: Auch zum Elektroauto gibt es eine Vielzahl an Spartipps. Doch bringen die wirklich was? Alexander Bloch erklärt welche Tipps sinnvoll sind - und welche ihr euch sparen könnt.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Langstreckenstar Hyundai Ioniq 6: Fast wie ein Verbrenner!
programme.desc: Oft fließt die Reichenweitenangst in die Kaufentscheidung von Elektro-Autos ein. Bei Verbrennern stellt sich diese Frage gar nicht: die Reichweiten sind hoch und nach einem fünfminütigen Tankstopp geht es für gewöhnlich weiter. Eignen sich Elektro-Autos auch als Reisebegleiter? Wie viel Reichweite ist wirklich nötig? Und wie viel Zeit muss ich für das Laden einplanen? All das beantwortet Alexander Bloch anhand des Hyundai Ioniq 6.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Ist Drehmoment wichtiger als Leistung? Die 5 größten Irrtümer zu PS & Co.
programme.desc: PS, Kilowatt und Newtonmeter benutzt man häufig, wenn man über Autos spricht. Dabei gibt es hier einige Stolperfallen. Sind PS in allen Ländern gleich? Newtonmeter gibt es nur beim Drehmoment? Alexander Bloch erklärt die 5 größten Irrtümer zu PS, Kilowatt und Co.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Kein Motoröl im E-Auto? 4 Irrtümer zu Öl im Elektroauto
programme.desc: Ein E-Auto braucht kein Öl und schon gar kein Motoröl. Ist das wirklich so? Chief Explanation Officer Alexander Bloch ist ins Forschungs- und Entwicklungszentrum von Petronas Lubricants gefahren, um mit den größten Öl-Irrtümern rund um die Elektromobilität und die Zukunft von Schmier- und Motorölen aufzuräumen.

programme.title: Einzeltest
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - BMW i5: Deutschland kann es doch!
programme.desc: Alexander Bloch bittet den BMW i5 eDrive40 zu einem ersten Check. Im ersten rein elektrischen 5er BMW sorgt der gleiche Elektromotor wie im BMW i4 eDrive40 für Vortrieb. Nun hat die E-Maschine mit mehr Gewicht zu kämpfen. Wie sich das auf die Reichweite und den Verbrauch auswirkt, ermittelt Bloch vor laufender Kamera. Dank Hands-Free-Driving geht das auch ohne Hände am Steuer.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Autonomes Fahren - Blick in die Zukunft mit autoELF
programme.desc: Die autoELF entstand im Projekt UNICARagil - ein autonomes Fahrzeug gemäß Level 4. Um autonom fahren zu können, braucht es viele verschiedene Sensoren - und die sind teuer. Alex Bloch lässt sich mit verschiedenen Manövern über die Teststrecke chauffieren und bespricht im Interview mit Prof. Dr.-Ing. Steven Peters die autonome Zukunft.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Die 5 Todsünden auf den ersten 1.000 km
programme.desc: Man hat lange gewartet und endlich ist es soweit: der Neuwagen ist da! Am liebsten würde man jetzt sofort ordentlich Gas geben. Aber Moment mal, war da nicht irgendwas? So ein neues Auto muss doch erst eingefahren werden, oder? Alexander Bloch erklärt, was auf den ersten 1.000 Kilometern zu beachten ist: Motor, Turbo, Bremsen, Dämpfer, Reifen - es gibt eine Menge zu tun.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - E-Auto-Highlights 2024: Auch ohne Förderung ein gutes Jahr
programme.desc: Auch 2024 kürt Alex Bloch wieder seine E-Auto-Highlights. Hier seht ihr die Top-Neuheiten: Günstig, schnell, viel Platz oder Offroad-tauglich. Hier ist für jeden etwas dabei!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Straße weiß, Akku leer? 4 E-Auto Winter-Mythen
programme.desc: Wenn es draußen frostig und kalt ist, kommt man mit dem E-Auto nur noch halb soweit und auch das Aufladen dauert doppelt so lang. Ist das wirklich so? Eisbär Alexander Bloch räumt mit den 4 gängigsten Winter-Mythen zu E-Autos auf.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Renault R5 im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Der Renault 5 feiert sein Comeback: Als elektrischer Kleinwagen im Retro-Design. Doch Optik ist nicht alles. Alexander Bloch prüft im E-Auto-Supertest, was der neue R5 bei Technik, Komfort und Platzangebot drauf hat. Auch Verbrauch, Reichweite und Dynamik stehen im Fokus. Ist der Renault 5 zurecht zum Auto des Jahres 2025 gewählt worden?

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der VW ID.7 im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Der ID.7 stellt die vierte Stufe der Elektromobilität bei VW dar. Die Fünf-Meter-Limo kommt mit einem neuen Elektromotor, neuen Features und Software und einer verbesserten Aerodynamik daher. Ob der ID.7 das beste Elektroauto unter 100.000 Euro im Supertest werden kann und damit den BWW i4 eDrive 40 entthront, prüft Alex im E-Auto Supertest.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Ford Explorer im Supertest – Wie gut ist er wirklich?
programme.desc: Der neue Ford Explorer mit 77 kWh Akku und Heckantrieb steht im Elektroauto-Supertest! Wie schlägt er sich in Effizienz, Qualität, Dynamik und Komfort? Ist er eine echte Alternative zu VW? Alex Bloch nimmt ihn genau unter die Lupe. Jetzt anschauen!

programme.title: Airline Disaster
programme.desc: Una squadra di terroristi dirotta un aereo di linea statunitense, lo Starquest, il più avanzato e grande aereo passeggeri del mondo. Quando Harriet Franklin, Presidente degli Stati Uniti, apprende che sull'aereo viaggia anche suo fratello, è chiamata a scegliere tra la sua famiglia e la sicurezza delle persone nelle città sottostanti, qualora il velivolo fosse costretto a schiantarsi al suolo.

programme.title: Air Collision
programme.desc: Una tempesta solare spazza via il sistema di controllo del traffico aereo. I passeggeri dell'Air Force One e quelli di un jet di linea si ritrovano in rotta di collisione nei cieli sopra il Midwest.

programme.title: Airplane Vs. Volcano
programme.desc: Un aereo di linea rimane intrappolato all'interno di un anello di vulcani in eruzione. I passeggeri e l'equipaggio devono trovare un modo per sopravvivere ad alta quota, senza atterrare. Quando, però, la lava e le ceneri scatenano paura e sfiducia tra tutti, non sono solo i vulcani a essere pericolosi. Tutti devono imparare a collaborare se vogliono sopravvivere a questo epico volo di fuoco.

programme.title: Flight Of Fear - Terrore Ad Alta Quota
programme.desc: I passeggeri e l'equipaggio di un volo vengono attaccati da forze invisibili che minacciano tutti a bordo, causando panico e caos.

programme.title: Ice 2020 - Parte 2
programme.desc: E ‘il 2020. I risultati di uno scienziato ambientale, il Professor Thom Archer suggeriscono che Halo, l’impresa di perforazione della società energetica sul ghiacciaio della Groenlandia ne stanno causando lo scioglimento. Gli avvertimenti di Archer vengono ignorati, così si dirige verso l’Artico per trovare prove inconfutabili. Al suo arrivo, si rende conto che l’umanità è in pericolo immediato, e corre a casa per salvare la sua famiglia. Il ghiacciaio collassa, con conseguenze devastanti...

programme.title: Alienate - Lotta Per La Terra
programme.desc: Ormai alla fine del suo matrimonio, David parte per un viaggio di lavoro per dare alla moglie un po' di spazio. Tuttavia, quando gli aerei cominciano a cadere misteriosamente dal cielo, si ritrova intrappolato in un'invasione aliena.

programme.title: The Recall - L'invasione
programme.desc: Charlie (RJ Mitte) si unisce ai suoi amici durante un weekend, in una cabina sul lago. Quella notte, un raggio di luce ultraterrena spunta giù dal cielo e rapisce gran parte del gruppo, portandolo sulla nave madre. I due superstiti, Charlie e Annie, devono fare affidamento su un eccentrico e misterioso cacciatore locale (Wesley Snipes), che sembra avere già esperienze dell'attacco.

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News
programme.desc: Hot Corn Cine News è un appuntamento settimanale pensato per aggiornare tutti sulle notizie più recenti del mondo del cinema. Un format nato dall’unione tra LoveTv Channel e la redazione di The Hot Corn.Irene Cortese e Sara Scarsella si occuperanno di raccontare tutto ciò che accade all’interno della redazione: tra ospiti, eventi e interviste. Ma non solo: proporranno anche notizie interessanti e parleranno delle prossime uscite in sala. Il tutto accompagnato da materiali video e trailer.

programme.title: Planet Of The Sharks
programme.desc: In un futuro non troppo lontano, lo scioglimento dei ghiacciai ha coperto d'acqua il 98% del pianeta. In questo scenario, gli squali hanno preso il sopravvento guidati da un esemplare geneticamente mutato. I pochi umani sopravvissuti vivono nel terrore ma ben presto un piccolo gruppo di disperati tenterà tutto il possibile per rendere le acque nuovamente sicure.

programme.title: Airline Disaster
programme.desc: Una squadra di terroristi dirotta un aereo di linea statunitense, lo Starquest, il più avanzato e grande aereo passeggeri del mondo. Quando Harriet Franklin, Presidente degli Stati Uniti, apprende che sull'aereo viaggia anche suo fratello, è chiamata a scegliere tra la sua famiglia e la sicurezza delle persone nelle città sottostanti, qualora il velivolo fosse costretto a schiantarsi al suolo.

programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo, un virus di proporzioni epiche ha devastato il pianeta Terra, dove il numero degli infetti supera quello delle persone sane e l'unica speranza è trovare una cura per sconfiggere l'epidemia. La dottoressa Lauren Chase ha un obiettivo ben preciso: portare la sua squadra sul campo e salvare il maggior numero di sopravvissuti.

programme.title: Night Of The Wild
programme.desc: In una città apparentemente tranquilla, un meteorite produce un effetto pericoloso sui cani che si trasformano in assassini feroci. Con gli abitanti costretti a difendersi da quelli che un tempo erano gli amici più fedeli, la giovane Roslyn si ritrova a cercare un modo per sopravvivere. Cosa faresti al suo posto?

programme.title: Un Natale Di Ghiaccio
programme.desc: Action movie ambientato tra i ghiacci dell’Alaska con Brendan Fehr e Jodelle Ferland. Siamo alla Vigilia di Natale e l’idillio delle feste viene bruscamente interrotto quando i ghiacciai, sciogliendosi, iniziano a rilasciare grandi quantità di metano liquido che, se non fermato, rischia di far esplodere l'intero pianeta.

programme.title: Brace For Impact - Indagine Ad Alta Quota
programme.desc: Tensione alle stelle in questo thriller che vede l'esperta di disastri aerei Sofia coinvolta in un'indagine per far chiarezza sulle reali cause di un tragico incidente in cui ha perso la vita il fratello. Il suo desiderio di giustizia la porterà a infrangere le regole del servizio di intelligence e a scoprire un complotto terroristico.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: China Bound：Xiamen
programme.desc: What's it like in one of China's happiest cities? Tianran is in sunny Xiamen on China's southeast coast, visiting the city's famous "island of music" and sampling local delicacies like shark meatballs, shacha noodles and fish in "soy sauce water". He'll discover former fishing villages turned hipster havens, drink tea with locals beneath traditional tenement buildings, and visit a student enclave brimming with creative startup energy.

programme.title: China Bound：Suzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He visits Suzhou, a historic city in eastern China famously admired by Marco Polo. Crisscrossed by canals, Suzhou is renowned for its exquisite gardens, where ancient scholars recreated nature's beauty within their own homes. Tianran discovers a city of refined tastes, where even a bowl of breakfast noodles comes with unspoken etiquette, locals insist on only in-season produce, and foodies eagerly await the arrival of prized hairy crabs.

programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu
programme.desc: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous "mala" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China : Shanghai
programme.desc: Balancing delicately on an alluvial plain and the Yangtze estuary of China’s east coast, much of Shanghai-literally meaning “on the sea”-sits at an average sea-level elevation of about 4 meters. Bisecting the city is the Huangpu River, dividing it into Puxi (west bank) and Pudong (east bank), where you’ll find its famous international airport. Join us as on an aerial cruise as we journey upstream towards one of the world’s most recognizable skylines.

programme.title: Jingmai Wanderings: A Symphony of Humans and Tea
programme.desc: As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Mount Jingmai embodies the ecological wisdom of forest–tea symbiosis and the rich cultural diversity of its ethnic communities. It plays a vital role in biodiversity conservation and the preservation of traditional tea culture. This episode follows the stories of representative individuals to explore three key themes — heritage preservation, ecological sustainability, and youth empowerment — revealing the unique charm and sustainable development model of Mount Jingmai.

programme.title: Suzhou Fans
programme.desc: Suzhou, known as the “Venice of China,” is also famous for its traditional crafts. And one of the most elegant and exquisite crafts is Suzhou fans. Celebrated for their exquisite design and fine quality, they’re popularly associated with literati. How come Suzhou gave birth to such a variety of fans? How can we appreciate their beauty in the modern world? In this episode, we are discovering more stories behind Suzhou fans.

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking. Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas. To reduce the danger, China’s shipbuilders came up with a solution. They developed Fu ships, commonly known as junks, incorporating a special watertight bulkhead technology. Their revolutionary design allowed the ships to withstand the highest winds and roughest waters. The Maritime Silk Road was an ancient trading route that connected China to Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. As a key passageway for trade and cultural exchange, it thrived for well over a thousand years, bringing Chinese tea, silk, porcelain, spices, and other precious cargo to the rest of the planet. The legacy of the Maritime Silk Road is still evident today in many parts of the world.

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China’s national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors—but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: China Bound: Chongqing
programme.desc: Join us in southwest China's Chongqing, one of the world's biggest cities. From futuristic skylines and cyberpunk streets, to fire-breathing opera, spicy hotpot and kungfu tea, we're diving deep into this megacity the size of Austria.

programme.title: China Bound: Guangzhou
programme.desc: Join us in Guangzhou, a global manufacturing hub in south China with a population as large as New York’s. From browsing hip street markets to wholesale clothes shopping, sampling world-famous Cantonese cuisine, and visiting the childhood home of kungfu legend Bruce Lee, there is plenty to do during our stay.

programme.title: China Bound: Wuhan
programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. Finally, he relives some of these moments through immersive theater performances set amongst historic buildings and aboard a steamship cruising the Yangtze River.

programme.title: China Bound: Harbin
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the "Ice City", host of the 2025 Asian Winter Games. Internationally renowned for its breathtaking ice and snow sculptures, the city thrives with activity despite it -20°C winters. From savoring the famous local ice cream and hearty northeastern Chinese dishes such as stewed goose and sweet-and-sour pork, to drifting on the frozen Songhua River and carving down the slopse of Yabuli Ski Resort, discover how much fun you can have in Harbin.

programme.title: China Bound: Tianjin
programme.desc: Tianran He explores the vibrant port city of Tianjin. Strolling through its historic quarters, he discovers how old buildings are being preserved and revitalized, and savors the rich flavors of authentic Tianjin cuisine. To work off the calories, he joins energetic retirees for a morning workout in the park, then takes in the lively nightlife along the banks of the Haihe River. From folk handicrafts on Ancient Culture Street to the National Maritime Museum and an aircraft carrier theme park, Tianran discovers that Tianjin is a truly multifacted city.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.1
programme.desc: When Zhejiang's winding river meets the sea it encounters a coastal region studded with islands. On this journey we survey a land of bays, bridges and harbors that is a glorious archipelago of memory, history and culture...

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: The Sichuan Zhuqin
programme.desc: Sichuan Zhuqin is a national intangible cultural heritage in China. Nowadays, its performances are constantly innovated, with new styles such as ensemble emerging. Creators have broken traditional performance methods, integrating Zhuqin with traditional Chinese instruments like the guzheng and erhu, and also experimenting with contemporary music forms such as rap and folk rock, aiming to make this traditional art appeal to more young audiences.

programme.title: Living Arts of Huizhou
programme.desc: This is Huangshan in eastern China. In this city, you’ll encounter one of China’s most traditional building styles: Hui-style architecture. How does Hui style set this region apart? What’s life like for people living in these houses? With these questions in mind, we’re embarking on a journey to decode Hui-style architecture.

programme.title: Fujian’s Tulou – The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature. Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint. A tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.

programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. Finally, he relives some of these moments through immersive theater performances set amongst historic buildings and aboard a steamship cruising the Yangtze River.

programme.title: China Bound: Harbin
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the "Ice City", host of the 2025 Asian Winter Games. Internationally renowned for its breathtaking ice and snow sculptures, the city thrives with activity despite it -20°C winters. From savoring the famous local ice cream and hearty northeastern Chinese dishes such as stewed goose and sweet-and-sour pork, to drifting on the frozen Songhua River and carving down the slopse of Yabuli Ski Resort, discover how much fun you can have in Harbin.

programme.title: China Bound: Tianjin
programme.desc: Tianran He explores the vibrant port city of Tianjin. Strolling through its historic quarters, he discovers how old buildings are being preserved and revitalized, and savors the rich flavors of authentic Tianjin cuisine. To work off the calories, he joins energetic retirees for a morning workout in the park, then takes in the lively nightlife along the banks of the Haihe River. From folk handicrafts on Ancient Culture Street to the National Maritime Museum and an aircraft carrier theme park, Tianran discovers that Tianjin is a truly multifacted city.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.1
programme.desc: When Zhejiang's winding river meets the sea it encounters a coastal region studded with islands. On this journey we survey a land of bays, bridges and harbors that is a glorious archipelago of memory, history and culture...

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: The Sichuan Zhuqin
programme.desc: Sichuan Zhuqin is a national intangible cultural heritage in China. Nowadays, its performances are constantly innovated, with new styles such as ensemble emerging. Creators have broken traditional performance methods, integrating Zhuqin with traditional Chinese instruments like the guzheng and erhu, and also experimenting with contemporary music forms such as rap and folk rock, aiming to make this traditional art appeal to more young audiences.

programme.title: Living Arts of Huizhou
programme.desc: This is Huangshan in eastern China. In this city, you’ll encounter one of China’s most traditional building styles: Hui-style architecture. How does Hui style set this region apart? What’s life like for people living in these houses? With these questions in mind, we’re embarking on a journey to decode Hui-style architecture.

programme.title: Fujian’s Tulou – The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature. Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint. A tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.

programme.title: China Bound: Chongqing
programme.desc: Join us in southwest China's Chongqing, one of the world's biggest cities. From futuristic skylines and cyberpunk streets, to fire-breathing opera, spicy hotpot and kungfu tea, we're diving deep into this megacity the size of Austria.

programme.title: China Bound: Guangzhou
programme.desc: Join us in Guangzhou, a global manufacturing hub in south China with a population as large as New York’s. From browsing hip street markets to wholesale clothes shopping, sampling world-famous Cantonese cuisine, and visiting the childhood home of kungfu legend Bruce Lee, there is plenty to do during our stay.

programme.title: Voces secretas
programme.desc: La criminologa Marta Colombo investiga el asesinato de un conocido y odiado empresario. Hay varios sospechosos y nadie sabe si saldra la verdad a la luz o si se hara justicia.

programme.title: Amateurs
programme.desc: Un hombre solitario enfrenta su jubilación cuando una joven afirma ser su hija y transforma su vida.

programme.title: El Camino
programme.desc: David y Eduardo Montalvo, dos hermanos que fueron abandonados por su madre, se convierten en ladrones para pagar la deuda de su padre.

programme.title: El Lobo
programme.desc: En la década de 1970, el servicio secreto de la dictadura española reclutó a un trabajador de la construcción para infiltrarse en el movimiento separatista vasco y convertirse en un informante para el Estado fascista.

programme.title: Amalia
programme.desc: Una mujer se obsesiona con la amante de su ex amante.

programme.title: Jaque Mate
programme.desc: David Hernández, conocido por ser el presentador del exitoso programa ficticio de juegos "Jaque Mate", se ve repentinamente sumergido en una pesadilla cuando recibe una llamada anónima durante una transmisión en vivo. El desconocido le informa que su hijo y esposa han sido secuestrados y que su vida depende de seguir las instrucciones que le dará en el programa. Aterrorizado y bajo la presión del secuestrador, David se ve obligado a convertir su programa en un escenario para cumplir con las demandas del criminal. Mientras la audiencia mira atónita, David debe resolver acertijos y desafíos en tiempo real para garantizar la seguridad de su familia. La tensión aumenta a medida que cada movimiento en el juego televisivo podría significar la diferencia entre la vida y la muerte para sus seres queridos. Determinado y enfrentando peligros desconocidos, David se embarca en una incansable búsqueda para reunir a su familia sana y salva, desafiando todo lo que le rodea para lograr su objetivo.

programme.title: Zapatillas Ferragamo
programme.desc: Rebeca es la hija de un poderoso mafioso, quien debe tomar el control del imperio de su padre después de que él es encarcelado.

programme.title: Krampack
programme.desc: Una historia española sobre la mayoría de edad que se centra en las travesuras de dos jóvenes de 17 años, que tienen una lujosa casa en la playa casi para ellos solos un verano. Este es un verano de despertares sexuales.

programme.title: Amalia

programme.title: Las Plantas
programme.desc: Florencia es una chica de 17 años que debe hacerse cargo de su hermano, que se encuentra en estado vegetativo. Tratando de sobrevivir sola y con problemas financieros, Florencia comenzará a quedar con desconocidos por internet y acabará obsesionándose con un cómic llamado -Las Plantas-, que trata de la invasión de unos espiritus vegetales en los cuerpos humanos cuando sale la luna llena.

programme.title: Zapatillas Ferragamo
programme.desc: Rebeca es la hija de un poderoso mafioso, quien debe tomar el control del imperio de su padre después de que él es encarcelado.

programme.title: Buffalo soldiers
programme.desc: 1989. El muro de Berlín está a punto de caer y el planeta va a convertirse en un lugar seguro según un nuevo orden mundial. El especialista Ray Elwood, en la Base del ejército norteamericano, está a punto de comprobar cómo su particular guerra fría se pone al rojo vivo. Elwood, bastante granuja, atiendo su trabajo como secretario del oficial superior. Cuando llega a la base un nuevo Sargento Primero, éste se dedicará a limpiarla de arriba abajo. Para mayor complicación, Elwood le echa el ojo a la hija del Sargento.

programme.title: Cuestion de Honor
programme.desc: Un Ranger del Ejército se infiltra en una familia mafiosa haciéndose pasar por asesino a sueldo. Junto con su tío, traman una venganza contra los asesinos que mataron a toda su familia cuando él era joven.

programme.title: Asalto a Wall Street
programme.desc: Jim, un neoyorquino corriente, vive con una esposa enferma pero cariñosa. De repente, todo cambia cuando la economía se hunde y lo pierde todo. Lleno de ira y rabia, Jim se propone vengarse de la vida que le han arrebatado.

programme.title: USS Seaviper
programme.desc: El submarino alemán, U-234, del puerto de Kiel está intercambiando carga con los japoneses. USS Seaviper debe localizar y detener este peligroso intercambio.

programme.title: Ace Bodyguard
programme.desc: Esta película cuenta la historia de Zhang Han, un guardaespaldas de élite «retirado», que une fuerzas con su antiguo compañero para rescatar a su esposa secuestrada.

programme.title: American Yakuza
programme.desc: Un agente americano del FBI es atraído por la mafia japonesa -la Yakuza- en esta película de acción.

programme.title: Avalanche Sharks
programme.desc: Después de una terrible avalancha, el personal de Twin Pines Resort Sky comienza a recibir informes sobre personas que han desaparecido y criaturas que se mueven bajo la nieve.

programme.title: Robot Apocalypse
programme.desc: Cuando la experta hacker Tara intenta detener a una poderosa inteligencia artificial que se apodera del ejército mundial, la inteligencia artificial la considera una terrorista que debe ser exterminada.

programme.title: La maldición de la tumba de Tutankamón 2
programme.desc: Hace miles de años gobernaba el gran rey niño Tutankamón. Pocos conocen los detalles de su vida y nadie conoce los secretos de su muerte. Pero todo está a punto de cambiar.

programme.title: Collider
programme.desc: En el año 2033, una joven atrapada en un misterioso orfanato viaja imprudentemente al pasado para encontrar a sus padres y enmendar su pasado.

programme.title: Geo Disaster V2
programme.desc: Una familia de Los Ángeles se ve separada durante la convergencia de los mayores desastres de la historia: un supervolcán, un megaterremoto y un tornado masivo, e intentarán reunirse a toda costa.

programme.title: Gagarin, Pionero del Espacio
programme.desc: El 12 de abril de 1961, el cosmonauta soviético Yuri Gagarin despegó en un cohete Vostok y orbitó alrededor de la Tierra durante 108 minutos. Seleccionado entre más de tres mil pilotos de combate de toda la Unión Soviética, Gagarin tuvo que entrenarse rápidamente para realizar el viaje de su vida.

programme.title: War of the world annihilation
programme.desc: Tras una dura invasión alienígena, la única esperanza de supervivencia de una madre y su hijo reside en descubrir una verdad impensable.

programme.title: El Túnel de los Huesos
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, mientras intentan una espectacular fuga, siete prisioneros hacen un extraño y aterrador descubrimiento en el túnel hacia su libertad.

programme.title: El valle Oscuro
programme.desc: Un jinete solitario llega a un remoto y aislado pueblo de los Alpes austríacos, donde, a pesar de no ser bienvenido, se le permite quedarse antes del duro invierno. Se presenta como un fotógrafo de Estados Unidos, pero nadie sospecha que el misterioso extranjero ha llegado al valle para cumplir una venganza. La violencia flota en el aire en este pueblo de leñadores, dominado por un viejo clan familiar que impone sus leyes, aterrorizando a sus habitantes.

programme.title: Bloodmoney
programme.desc: Un cartel de la drogue colombien s'associe à un groupe de triades de Hong Kong et au tueur à gages le plus chaud de la planète, pour expédier deux tonnes de cocaïne en Australie et en Chine.

programme.title: Les Rebelles de PT-218
programme.desc: En pleine Seconde Guerre mondiale, l'océan Atlantique devient un champ de bataille mortel lorsqu'un torpilleur américain se bat contre le bombardement constant des forces allemandes

programme.title: Crash lunaire
programme.desc: Deux entreprises, l'une sidérurgique et l'autre aérospatiale, décident de s'associer afin d'exploiter les ressources de la Lune. Mais, un accident de forage provoque une fissure et précipite un morceau de l'astre sélène vers la Terre.

programme.title: Vampire Killers
programme.desc: Leurs femmes ayant été réduites en esclavage par la meute locale de vampires lesbiennes à cause d'une ancienne malédiction, les hommes restants d'un village rural envoient deux jeunes garçons malheureux dans les landes pour les sacrifier.

programme.title: The Tower
programme.desc: Au cour de la « White Christmas » parti du complexe ultra-luxueux « Sky Tower », un feu se déclare. Le feu a commencé lorsque les hélicoptères supposés saupoudrer de la neige au-dessus du bâtiment sont entrés en contact avec le bâtiment. Les pompiers sont rapidement envoyés afin de sauver l’ensemble des locataires et les invités VIP du building.

programme.title: Assaut sur Wall Street
programme.desc: Jim est un New-Yorkais ordinaire menant une vie paisible avec un emploi bien rémunéré et une famille aimante. Soudain, tout bascule lorsque l’économie s’effondre, faisant perdre à Jim tout ce qu’il avait. Rempli de colère et de rage, Jim craque et va jusqu’à l’extrême pour se venger de la vie qu’on lui a arrachée.

programme.title: L'enfant d'Osiris
programme.desc: Dans une époque de colonisation interplanétaire, Sy Lombrok (Kellan Lutz), un ancien infirmier devenu vagabond au passé tourmenté, forme une alliance improbable avec Kane Sommerville (Daniel MacPherson), un lieutenant travaillant pour le sous-traitant militaire Exor. Dans une course contre la montre, ils tentent de sauver Indi (Teagan Croft), la jeune fille de Kane, alors qu’une crise mondiale imminente provoquée par Exor menace la planète.

programme.title: Funeral Killers
programme.desc: Un jeu du chat et de la souris se déroule au cours d'une seule nuit, lorsque trois criminels armés font irruption dans une morgue et exigent que le médecin légiste et son assistant leur remettent une balle logée dans un cadavre. Alors que les criminels tentent désespérément de cacher leur véritable identité, le médecin se retrouve de plus en plus enlisé dans un bourbier, son passé le rattrapant malgré lui. Chaque rebondissement explosif pousse bientôt les personnages au-delà de leurs limites.

programme.title: Midnight Heat
programme.desc: Un banquier amnésique se cache de la police lorsqu'il est accusé du meurtre de sa femme.

programme.title: Incoming
programme.desc: La station spatiale internationale est désormais une prison - le site noir par excellence. Personne n'en sort. Et personne ne sait qu'elle est là. Mais lorsque les terroristes emprisonnés prennent le contrôle de la station et la transforment en un missile visant Moscou, seuls un pilote de navette et un médecin débutant peuvent les arrêter. Leur tâche est compliquée par un agent de la CIA véreux (Scott Adkins) qui a ses propres plans pour la station et les terroristes qui s'y trouvent.

programme.title: Battle Drone
programme.desc: 6 mercenaires sont engagés par la CIA pour enlever l'héritier d'une république et éliminer un marchand d'armes à Moscou et reçoivent une autre mission à Tchernobyl où la trahison les attend.

programme.title: La Prison
programme.desc: UN ANCIEN POLICIER CONDAMNÉ REJOINT UN SYNDICAT DU CRIME SECRET AU SEIN DE LA PRISONYu-gon (KIM Rae-won), ancien inspecteur de police tourmenté, est incarcéré pour un délit de fuite. En prison, il découvre que tout l’établissement est contrôlé par un détenu nommé Ik-ho (HAN Seok-kyu), qui dirige un syndicat du crime avec l’aide du directeur et des gardiens, leur fournissant ainsi l’alibi parfait. Rapidement, Yu-gon devient un membre clé de l’empire criminel d’Ik-ho.

programme.title: Desert Strike
programme.desc: Un ancien militaire au passé mystérieux conduit un groupe de réfugiés égyptiens à travers le désert et doit les protéger d'un groupe de mercenaires diaboliques.

programme.title: Maximum Impact
programme.desc: Une équipe d'agents russes et américains s'assemblent pour sauver la petite-fille du Secrétaire de la Défense américain. Kidnappée par un syndicat du crime asiatique, sa disparition pourrait déclencher une crise financière mondiale.

programme.title: Una pistola para cien cruces
programme.desc: Un irlandés es asesinado en el salvaje Oeste. Su hijo Jimmy sale en busca de los asesinos de su padre, pero pronto cae en una emboscada de dos salteadores de caminos y es asesinado también. Django (o Sartana, según la versión de la película) lo encuentra y lee la carta que Jimmy había recibido de su hermana Jessica Dublin contándole el asesinato de su padre.

programme.title: La Rivolta Dei Mercenari
programme.desc: In un territorio sconvolto dalla ribellione, un gruppo di spietati mercenari viene ingaggiato per reprimere una rivolta, ma tradimenti e ambizioni personali accendono una lotta feroce per il potere.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP25 - Escape a la ponderosa
programme.desc: Tres desertores escaparon de una empalizada del Ejército a la Ponderosa. Cuando un capitán viene a buscarlos, Ben se da cuenta de lo que han tenido que aguantar y promete contarle la verdad a su buen amigo que está al mando de ese fuerte.

programme.title: L'arciere Nero
programme.desc: Nel cuore del Medioevo, un abile arciere combatte contro tirannia e ingiustizie, guidando la ribellione del popolo tra agguati, duelli e intrighi di corte. Tra eroismo e vendetta, la sua lotta diventa simbolo di libertà.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP21 - La subvención española
programme.desc: Los Cartwright intentan refutar la validez de una concesión de tierras española para impedir que la familia De La Cuesta se apodere de parte de Ponderosa y de todas las tierras de los colonos de Carson Valley.

programme.title: Samoa, Regina Della Giungla
programme.desc: Diretto da Guido Malatesta, con Edwige Fenech.Tra giungle inesplorate e pericoli nascosti, una coraggiosa regina guida il suo popolo contro invasori e tradimenti, tra azione e avventura.

programme.title: El último rebelde
programme.desc: La aventura de dos soldados rebeldes tras el fin de la Guerra Civil.

programme.title: La Regina Delle Amazzoni
programme.desc: Con Gianna Maria Canale, in un regno di guerriere leggendarie, intrighi e battaglie accendono la lotta per il potere.

programme.title: Corsicana
programme.desc: El ayudante del sheriff Bass Reeves se reencuentra con su antiguo compañero y fugitivo Sam Tanner. Junto con un antiguo francotirador de la Unión, se enfrentan a una carrera contrarreloj para seguir la pista de Jack Donner y su despiadada banda de asesinos.

programme.title: L'ira Di Achille
programme.desc: Sullo sfondo della guerra di Troia, Achille affronta battaglie e passioni travolgenti guidato dall’onore e dalla sete di vendetta.

programme.title: Death Alley
programme.desc: En 1892, la banda de los Dalton se propuso convertirse en los forajidos más famosos de Estados Unidos. Este sueño se convirtió en pesadilla.

programme.title: Lo Sceicco Rosso
programme.desc: Nel cuore del deserto, un misterioso sceicco guida ribellioni e intrighi tra tribù rivali e poteri coloniali, tra azione e colpi di scena. Diretto da Ferdinando Cerchio.

programme.title: La venganza de Calamity Jane
programme.desc: Un western que aborda de forma diferente la muerte de Wild Bill Hickok y la venganza que Calamity Jane emprende contra los hombres que conspiraron para matarlo. Mientras Jane está a la caza, tomándose la justicia por su mano, un agente de la ley recluta la ayuda del amigo de Jane, Colorado Charlie Utter, para seguir la pista de Jane y detenerla antes de que vaya demasiado lejos.

programme.title: Cyrano Contro D'artagnan
programme.desc: Tra duelli e intrighi di corte, Cyrano e D’Artagnan si affrontano e si alleano tra rivalità e onore, in un’avventura ricca di azione e spirito cavalleresco.

programme.title: La Fiebre de la Pradera
programme.desc: El ex sheriff borracho Preston Biggs consigue un billete de salida de la cárcel y un puñado de dinero para escoltar a tres novias por correo rechazadas medio locas hasta el tren más cercano de vuelta al Este.

programme.title: El último hijo
programme.desc: Un forajido intenta acabar con su descendencia eliminando a su malvada línea consanguínea.

programme.title: Maciste All'inferno
programme.desc: Tra inferi, magie oscure e creature demoniache, Maciste affronta una sfida estrema per salvare innocenti dal male.

programme.title: Territorio hostil
programme.desc: En los Estados Unidos postguerra civil, cuando se presume que un soldado de la Unión está muerto, sus hijos son enviados por error en el tren de los huérfanos.

programme.title: Maciste Contro I Cacciatori Di Teste
programme.desc: In terre selvagge e misteriose, Maciste sfida tribù feroci e pericoli mortali per salvare innocenti e ristabilire la pace.

programme.title: Sonora
programme.desc: En 1931 en México, bajo la presión del gobierno de Sonora, un grupo de personas se ven obligadas a viajar a Mexicalli, donde se enfrentan al racismo y a otros peligros en el desierto

programme.title: Genoveffa Di Brabante - La Lancia Della Vendetta
programme.desc: Accusata ingiustamente di tradimento, Genoveffa viene esiliata e costretta a sopravvivere nei boschi con il figlio, affrontando fame e pericoli mentre la verità cerca di emergere.

programme.title: I Coltelli Del Vendicatore
programme.desc: Tra intrighi e vendetta in un’ambientazione nordica, un uomo combatte contro tradimenti e usurpatori per ristabilire giustizia, tra duelli e colpi di scena. Diretto da Mario Bava e Leopoldo Savona.

programme.title: Ases y Ochos
programme.desc: Los pacíficos colonos de una ciudad destinada a la grandeza del ferrocarril se arriesgan a establecerse en el inexplorado Oeste y, de repente, son asesinados a tiros sin piedad. Sin ley ni orden, la justicia recae sobre los hombros de un anciano ranchero y un pistolero consumado pero retirado.

programme.title: Maciste Gladiatore Di Sparta
programme.desc: Tra arene, rivolte e battaglie spettacolari, Maciste sfida il potere per liberare gli oppressi e cambiare il destino di Sparta

programme.title: El calle de los conflictos
programme.desc: Un sheriff intenta detener los conflictos entre colonos en el Oeste tras la Guerra de Secesión.

programme.title: Tharus Figlio Di Attila
programme.desc: Tra invasioni, vendette e battaglie epiche, il figlio di Attila sfida nemici e tradimenti per difendere il suo popolo

programme.title: Lone Rider
programme.desc: Con un alentador drama familiar y una acción que sube la adrenalina, Lone Rider es un western con agallas, gloria y un poderoso mensaje. Bob Hattaway, un soldado honrado, regresa a su pueblo natal del Oeste para descubrir que el terrateniente corrupto Stu Croaker se ha convertido en el hombre más poderoso del condado.

programme.title: I Sette Gladiatori
programme.desc: Un grande film d'avventura con scontri fino all'ultimo sangue. Il gladiatore Dario, libero grazie alle sue vittorie, torna in patria. Qui, al posto del padre che vi governava, trova un tiranno usurpatore che l'ha ucciso. Con l'aiuto di sei validi combattenti, cercherà di rimettere tutto al proprio posto.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: El inspector Leduque llega de Nueva Orleans a Virginia City para detener a Ben Cartwright por un asesinato cometido hace 20 años. Cuando Ben declara públicamente que se retira de la carrera por la gobernación, la gente del pueblo se molesta no sólo por esto, sino que Little Joe también ha sido acusado de matar a tiros a sangre fría al ayudante de Leduque.

programme.title: La Vengeza de los cheyennes
programme.desc: Cuando Charlotte Sutter es secuestrada por los apaches, su hermano Sam, ayudado por un viejo prospector borracho, va en su busca.

programme.title: I Pirati Della Malesia
programme.desc: Tra esotiche terre d’Oriente, il leggendario Sandokan guida i suoi uomini contro il dominio coloniale, tra battaglie navali e avventure senza sosta. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi, con Steve Reeves.

programme.title: Randy Cabalga Alone
programme.desc: Encarcelado por unos asesinatos que no cometió, Randy escapa sólo para tropezar con la guarida de los verdaderos asesinos.

programme.title: Au-delà de la haine
programme.desc: Une famille de pionniers est presque entièrement détruite par des Indiens en quête de vengeance : Le petit George est laissé évanoui sur le sol, et sa petite sœur adoptée par le chef indien. Le destin les réunira à nouveau.

programme.title: Amigo!... Mon colt a deux mots à te dire
programme.desc: Un vagabond aux poings rapides et un proxénète armé de pistolets rapides aident un enfant à réclamer son héritage.

programme.title: Son nom est Pote
programme.desc: Après que Pot et son frère Ray aient dévalisé une banque, Pot est arrêté mais parvient à s'échapper. Il rencontre un bandit nommé Steve et ils complotent pour cambrioler une autre banque locale. Avec l'aide d'un croque-mort qui creuse ses tombes à la dynamite, ils réussissent à vider le coffre-fort. Cependant, ce que Pot ne sait pas, c'est que Steve coopère avec Lobo, un bandit mexicain, qui capture Ray afin de s'approprier tout l'argent.

programme.title: Furie au Missouri
programme.desc: Pendant les derniers mois de la guerre de Sécession, le frère de Joe est injustement tué par Clifford, un capitaine de l'armée nordiste. Joe décide de rejoindre un groupe de Sudistes déterminés à résister jusqu'au bout.

programme.title: Les colts de la violence
programme.desc: Il y a douze ans, Sartana a fait accuser son frère Johnny de meurtre et lui a volé sa petite amie. Devenu le chef incontesté de la ville et choyé par sa mère possessive, Sartana semble en sécurité - jusqu'à ce que, sa peine purgée, Johnny revienne en ville.

programme.title: Trinita va tout casser
programme.desc: Les victimes de Honey, le chef oppressif de la ville, reçoivent l'aide d'une alliance inhabituelle entre des hommes armés et des artistes de cirque.

programme.title: Mallory 'M' comme la mort
programme.desc: Il y a douze ans, Sartana a fait accuser son frère Johnny de meurtre et lui a volé sa petite amie. Devenu le chef incontesté de la ville et choyé par sa mère possessive, Sartana semble en sécurité - jusqu'à ce que, sa peine purgée, Johnny revienne en ville.

programme.title: La Charge des Cosaques
programme.desc: L'histoire de Hadji Murad, un chef tchétchène du XIXe siècle qui a mené ses guerriers dans une lutte contre les forces d'invasion du tsar russe.

programme.title: Un bounty killer à Trinita
programme.desc: Les habitants de Trinity décident d'engager un chasseur de primes notoire pour les protéger d'une bande de hors-la-loi mexicains qui sème la terreur dans la région. Il découvre que le véritable instigateur de ces bandits se cache en ville. Une fusillade sanglante met fin à l'emprise de la bande et rend le contrôle de la ville à ses habitants.

programme.title: Un dollar entre les dents
programme.desc: Un pistolero solitaire tente de conclure un marché avec un bandit mexicain pour se partager un chargement d'or volé, ce qui donne lieu à un jeu de trahisons sans merci entre les deux hommes.

programme.title: Big Kill
programme.desc: Un novice venu de Philadelphie, deux parieurs marginaux en fuite et un prédicateur impitoyable ont rendez-vous avec le destin dans une ville en plein essor tombée en ruine, appelée Big Kill.

programme.title: Hercule contre les tyrans de Babylone
programme.desc: Le roi Shalmaneser, Assur et sa sœur sorcière Tanit, tyrans de Babylone, retiennent prisonniers des Hellènes, dont Esperia, reine d'Hellas. Hercule intervient pour la sauver, punir les tyrans cruels et libérer le peuple.

programme.title: Le temps du massacre
programme.desc: Un chercheur d'or et son demi-frère ivrogne doivent affronter un fermier et son fils sadique après avoir pris le contrôle de sa ferme.

programme.title: Django Kill... Tire encore si tu peux
programme.desc: Diverses factions, dont un bandit métis, une bande de cow-boys homosexuels et un prêtre, se disputent l'or volé dans une ville surréaliste.

programme.title: Les Impitoyables
programme.desc: Un prêtre et son frère jumeau se relaient pour défendre une petite ville contre le gang vicieux des Clayton.

programme.title: Cocinísima T01
programme.desc: El chef Mariano Sandoval nos lleva de la mano aprendiendo hacer increíbles platillos internacionales con fáciles recetas de cocina.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle - La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Andrea Tabachnik nos comparte su poderosa historia como ex-tenista de alto rendimiento, maratonista, psicóloga clínica y emprendedora del movimiento. Desde los entrenamientos intensivos que comenzaron en su infancia hasta el momento en que decidió cambiar de rumbo, Andrea habla con honestidad sobre el duelo que implica soltar una identidad construida en el deporte competitivo. Andrea transforma su experiencia personal en inspiración para otros a través de su estudio, donde promueve una nueva forma de moverse: desde lo invisible, lo auténtico y lo emocionalmente sostenible.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Sergio Gutiérrez, actor, guionista y director independiente, sobre sus inicios en la actuación, su pasión por los escenarios y el proceso de construir personajes completos. Con una trayectoria que incluye participaciones en series de televisión, streaming y teatro, Sergio comparte anécdotas de sets masivos, entrenamientos con dobles de riesgo y su paso por producciones como míticas. Reflexionamos sobre la importancia de no juzgar a sus propios personajes, la presencia total en escena, y el valor del capital humano en tiempos de inteligencia artificial. Una charla auténtica y dinámica que revela lo que significa vivir la actuación desde todas sus trincheras.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle - La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Nos acompaña Clara Corona de Lau, consultora en cultura organizacional, fundadora de Think Lynk y pionera en transformar la forma en que vivimos nuestro espacio laboral. Reconocida por múltiples presidentes de México y galardonada con el Premio Nacional del Empresario, Clara nos comparte su visión sobre liderazgo, bienestar y propósito dentro del entorno laboral. Descubrimos los pilares que hacen de una empresa un lugar extraordinario: confianza, valores, empatía y una cultura sólida. También exploramos la historia de su reconocida empresa “Biomédica de Referencia”, ejemplo de excelencia y humanidad. Un episodio inspirador que revela cómo la cultura organizacional no es un lujo, sino el corazón mismo del éxito.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle - La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Viajamos con Lety Zetune, experta en experiencias de lujo y agente de viajes de NUBA, nominada como una de las mejores agencias de México. Con ella, descubrimos por qué viajar no solo es una forma de conocer el mundo, sino también de reconectar contigo mismo.Desde los mejores destinos para una despedida de soltera, hasta los rincones más exóticos para una luna de miel, Lety nos guía a través de los secretos de planear un viaje inolvidable. En una charla cercana y divertida con nuestros conductores, derriba mitos sobre aerolíneas low cost, comparte tips para realizar presupuestos, revela sus destinos favoritos en México y nos cuenta cómo convirtió un viaje familiar en una búsqueda del tesoro en Machu Picchu.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle - La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.
